sources.name: lms.interaction
gaps: Publication is best effort after the source write; historical reconciliation requires its owner.

sources.name: recommendation.event
sources.privacy: restricted-identifiers; tracking token and arbitrary metadata excluded
gaps: Producer returns accepted=false on broker failure; client retry and source reconciliation are not guaranteed.
Conversational preference and candidate-set provenance are not yet emitted.

sources.name: ai.llm_attempt
sources.privacy: usage metadata only; no API key identifiers, errors, prompts or responses
gaps: Historical rows do not carry reliable actor/course attribution.
Existing failures or absent provider usage may have stored zero tokens; export marks these unknown.
Unversioned model catalog prices are not historical cost evidence.

sources.name: auth.login
sources.privacy: verified actor and auth method only; no credentials/IP
gaps: No verified login publisher; token refresh must not be counted as interactive login.

sources.name: ai.agent_turn
sources.privacy: artifact references/hashes; content requires separately governed storage
gaps: Current traces lack complete actor, artifact version and policy provenance.

sources.name: lab.submission
sources.privacy: metadata only; exclude code and hidden test cases
gaps: Runtime job status is not a verified submission fact.

sources.name: chat.message
sources.privacy: no message text, attachments, IP or access tokens
gaps: WebSocket and Redis delivery do not form a durable warehouse source.

sources.name: personalize.profile
sources.privacy: derived learning evidence; version and purpose required
gaps: Derived records must retain policy/input-window provenance and must not duplicate raw learning counts.

sources.name: platform.service_metrics
gaps: Counter reset and scrape availability must be modelled; not a user-activity source.
